title: Bacoor City eyeing waste-to-energy technology amid garbage problem

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – With more than half a million kilograms of waste generated daily, Bacoor City is eyeing waste-to-energy (WTE) technology as a potential long-term solution to its garbage management problem. Mayor Strike Revilla said in a Facebook post on Thursday that the city generates about 533,622.98 kilograms of waste every day. “In response to this challenge, we are pushing for a study on Waste-to-Energy (WTE) technology as a long-term solution to the city’s waste management problem, in line with our 10-Year Solid Waste Management Plan,” Revilla said in his post in Filipino.
